name: Marinaleda (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the round emblem of Marinaleda (a dove over a landscape, inscribed MARINALEDA — UNA UTOPÍA HACIA LA PAZ).
history: The flag of Marinaleda is three horizontal stripes of equal width, with the arms at the centre of the flag.

features.role: Marinaleda emblem — dove over a landscape within a ring inscribed MARINALEDA UNA UTOPÍA HACIA LA PAZ
